scope: PALOMAR_OBSERVED_NIGHT/JPFM-2E versus 2026 Scientific Reports ML result
What TOPA may later absorb from the ML method after harmonization

literal_58_reflection.interpretation: The historical pair is not geographically exceptional under the literal 58°-parallel reflection. The old 'confirmed' label is withdrawn scientifically but remains preserved historically.

antipodal_negative_control.role: Negative control only. No further operator shopping is permitted in this artifact.

geographic_correction.correct_label: Open southern Indian Ocean, west-southwest of the Crozet Archipelago; not geographically near the Kerguelen Archipelago.
geographic_correction.official_crozet_context: TAAF places Crozet in the southern Indian Ocean between approximately 45°95′–46°50′ S and 50°33′–52°58′ E.

formula_provenance_gate.reason: The v25.4 artifact stores the Eye coordinate, coherence score, and an interpretation involving 0.99 and -0.96 vectors, but it does not specify a deterministic equation that generates (-47.3,47.9) from frozen inputs.
formula_provenance_gate.forbidden_action: Do not reverse-engineer a formula that lands on the already-known Eye coordinate and then present that fit as validation.
required_before_null: then run the null without moving the Eye

janus_open_jpfm_2e.key_identity: In this dense S0 cohort, ANY_CANDIDATE equals PALOMAR_OBSERVED_NIGHT on every observed night.
janus_open_jpfm_2e.claim: No robust positive nuclear enhancement survives the tile-opportunity-normalized rate test in this open reconstruction.

scientific_reports_2026_closed_ml.calibration_note: Isotonic calibration was attempted but collapsed the probability distribution; raw mean ensemble scores were used as candidate 'probability' scores.
scientific_reports_2026_closed_ml.nuclear_test_source: US DOE/NV-209 Rev.16; U.S. above-ground tests; ±1 day window
scientific_reports_2026_closed_ml.primary_nuclear_statistic: For each observed date, sum ML scores across transients; compare mean weighted count for 26 nuclear-window dates versus non-nuclear dates using 10,000 random permutations of nuclear-window labels.
important_limits: The model uses expert visual labels without an objective gold standard; the paper acknowledges this.
The primary reviewer is a co-discoverer of the transient phenomenon; the second reviewer was trained by the primary reviewer and disagreements were resolved by discussion.
AUC measures discrimination, not probability calibration; raw ensemble scores should not automatically be interpreted as calibrated probabilities.
The nuclear test uses weighted nightly counts on observed dates but does not expose an explicit nightly sky-area/tile/plate-opportunity offset comparable to JPFM-2E.
The reported 370 observed dates and 626 plates do not match JANUS open S0's 312 observed nights and 640 plates; this is direct evidence that the cohorts/opportunity universes are not identical.
Lag -3..+3 analyses were post-hoc sensitivity analyses and cannot upgrade the primary claim.

independent_open_reconstruction.method: negative binomial nightly candidate counts with observed grid patches as exposure
independent_open_reconstruction.interpretation: An independently constructed open pipeline also finds the opportunity-normalized temporal association inconclusive/null despite recovering substantial catalog structure.

not_a_direct_contradiction_because: closed 107,875 cohort != JANUS open 122,511 S0 cohort != Hayes 2.85M cohort
370 observation dates != 312 JANUS observed nights != 368 Hayes nights
ML-weighted nightly count != raw candidate count with explicit tile exposure offset
US DOE above-ground calendar != JANUS OPEN_ALL_REPORTED_125 SIPRI-derived calendar unless membership is harmonized
randomly permuting nuclear labels across observed dates does not by itself normalize variable nightly observed area/opportunity
what_is_strengthened: Artifact contamination is a real and large methodological issue and ML scoring is a promising way to reduce it.
The closed cohort contains a statistically non-null signal under the authors' frozen primary weighted-count test.
The open reconstructions demonstrate that observation opportunity must be explicitly modeled before generalizing the nuclear-window claim.

useful_guards: plate-center nearness is not exact footprint membership
claim ceiling remains plate provenance only
janus_cosmos_role.firewall: LOVE/EDEM/Stargate semantics must not be pooled as evidence for the nuclear/POSS-I association merely because the same Palomar infrastructure is used.

required_same-test_contract: same exact nuclear-event manifest and ±1 definition
same observed-night/date universe or an explicit intersection analysis
same opportunity denominator: tiles, patches, usable plate area, or exposure-equivalent
same count model with log(opportunity) offset (primary: negative binomial unless preregistered diagnostics reject it)
same nuisance ladder: season, year/month, sky footprint, acquisition/astrometry, lunar, geomagnetic where available
grouped CV by plate/date for any retrained classifier to reduce same-plate leakage
nuclear labels forbidden from classifier features and hyperparameter selection
score calibration assessed separately from discrimination; if calibration fails, call outputs scores/ranks, not probabilities
ml_absorption_gate.success_condition: A materially positive nuclear coefficient/effect survives the same exposure-normalized model in both the closed ML-scored cohort and the open reconstruction, with compatible direction and without dependence on one dataset-specific calendar/opportunity definition.
ml_absorption_gate.failure_condition: Significance that disappears under shared opportunity normalization, changes sign, or exists only in one cohort remains dataset-specific and cannot support a general nuclear-window claim.
forbidden_absorption: authors' substantive nuclear/UAP interpretation as a prior
uncalibrated ensemble outputs mislabeled as physical probabilities

one_line_verdict: The mirror claim dies; the Eye remains a historical coordinate with a missing generating formula; the POSS-I nuclear-window signal survives as a real contested statistical question, but ML must not enter TOPA as authority until the closed and open cohorts survive one shared exposure-normalized test.
